inspection_status_legend.FEDERALLY_INSPECTED: FSIS continuous inspection; product may enter interstate commerce when produced under federal grant.
inspection_status_legend.STATE_INSPECTED: Arkansas MPI 'at least equal to' FMIA; product limited to intrastate commerce unless CIS (AR not CIS as of CC-SRC-130).
inspection_status_legend.CUSTOM_EXEMPT: Slaughter for owner(s) of the animal; generally not for commercial retail sale of meat.
inspection_status_legend.RETAIL_EXEMPT: Limited retail exemptions — not a general packing pathway.
inspection_status_legend.UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_VERIFICATION: Directory conflict or unverified secondary claim.

hard_limits: No invented appointment wait times or prices
